BREAKING: South Korea's exports surged +72.5% YoY in August, their largest annual increase on record.

This follows a +63.0% gain in July and marks the 2nd consecutive monthly improvement.

South Korean exports have now seen above +40.0% YoY growth for 7-straight months.

JAPAN TURNS TO AI SATELLITES FOR FASTER DEFENSE RESPONSE

The Defense Ministry will work with Japanese companies to build test satellites between fiscal 2027 and 2029.
